findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects such as the vendor roster uploaded to this bucket may be stored without encryption at rest unless each upload explicitly requests it.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, so ledger export objects can be written without encryption at rest.
The bucket lacks a default server-side encryption configuration, leaving model artifacts unencrypted at rest when upload clients do not set encryption.
No default server-side encryption is configured for this bucket, allowing runbook content to be stored without encryption at rest.
